newsitem.title: USA: Municipal sales total $1.8 bln for Tuesday Dec 3.
newsitem.headline: Municipal sales total $1.8 bln for Tuesday Dec 3.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $1.8 billion in 63 offerings for Tuesday, December 3, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $670 million in 33 issues. The largest issue is a $167 million Pittsburgh, Pa., refunding bond issue at 1030 EST.

Negotiated sales total $1.08 billion in 30 offerings for Tuesday. The largest issue is a $210 million Florida Ports Commission revenue bond issue through Merrill Lynch & Co. --U.S. Municipal Information Group, 212-859-1826
